svg.title: Merzkava Universe — The Arcanistry Investigation Wall
svg.desc: An antique, layered investigation wall inspired by Reverse: 1999, with scattered archival photographs, academy dossiers, research notes, maps, pinned papers, and extremely fine pale-blue and red evidence threads. It presents the canon education route, four Tianhai academies, the exclusive Tianhai Arcanist Institute, Arcanist progression, formation engraving, research fields, and established historical evidence.
